mechanism_narrative: A surge in housing starts (HOUST) above 2000 units signals increased consumer confidence, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:historical correlation between HOUST and consumer confidence indices
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 50% of instances when HOUST > 2000, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) above 5% signals tightening monetary conditions, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in tightening periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An unexpected drop in unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4.5% signals a strong labor market, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, but only if payroll employment (PAYEMS) is also increasing.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 40% of instances when UNRATE < 4.5% and PAYEMS is increasing, or Rank IC < 0.01 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A steady increase in industrial production (INDPRO) above its 6-month moving average signals strengthening supply chains, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns during supply chain strengthening periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in GDP (GDPC1) below its 12-month moving average signals decreased consumer spending, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:historical GDP and consumer spending correlations
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 40% of instances when GDPC1 is below its 12mo MA, or Rank IC < 0.01 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) coupled with a rise in consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) above 3% signals inflationary pressures, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS is increasing and CPIAUCSL > 3%, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A consistent increase in payroll employment (PAYEMS) above its 3-month moving average, without a corresponding rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE), signals a strong labor market, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 40% of instances when PAYEMS is increasing and UNRATE is steady, or Rank IC < 0.01 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Retail sales (RSAFS) consistently above their 6-month moving average signal sustained consumer demand, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, regardless of other macro conditions.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns during sustained retail sales growth periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).
